approval.reason: Bootstrap r1 baseline for Galaxy Fold8 ko-KR. Candidate v2 validation passed with clean provenance. Water Leak and Motion Sensor battery announcements were manually verified as false positives caused by the known TTS observation limitation. Home Monitor Settings remains an accepted environment-scoped known accessibility limitation. Clothing Care traversal diagnostics are acknowledged as non-blocking automation-engine diagnostics.

automation_acknowledgments.comment: Known traversal termination/recovery diagnostic on the Clothing Care screen. Preserved in the approval audit and accepted as a non-blocking automation-engine diagnostic.

structured_limitations.comment: Manually verified on the Fold8 target device. TalkBack correctly announces the battery percentage. The empty automated speech result is caused by the known TTS observation limitation.
